title: Beatrix and the Gravity
author: Mara Sandoval
blurb: Xanthe Pemberton, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
